description: An older teenager exploring life after high school without ranking or prestige pressure.

leaving_behind: standardized test preparation as a full-time occupation
choosing subjects only to impress admissions readers
wants_to_add: a realistic look at several post-secondary paths
conversations with adults doing work she admires
a portfolio that reflects real projects
practical_constraints: in-state tuition is the realistic ceiling
no travel budget for campus visits
intake.additional_context: The family wants college to stay one option among several rather than the only acceptable outcome.
